content:
A Laredo man was arrested October 18 on assault and drug possession charges after allegedly striking his ex-girlfriend, according to the Laredo Morning Times. The suspect was identified as Mario Alberto Fuentes, 28, and the arrest took place in Laredo.

The case pairs an alleged domestic assault with a separate drug possession charge — two charges that, taken together, tell a familiar and ugly story about how domestic violence cases often intersect with substance abuse. Police have not publicly released further details about either charge.

What happens next is in the court system's hands: whether prosecutors pursue both charges, and what the case files say when they become public, will determine whether this arrest was the beginning of accountability or just another booking photo. Webb Watch 956 will keep an eye on the court record.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, "Man accused of striking ex-girlfriend arrested for assault, drug possession," Oct. 20, 2026.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
